status: case definitions only; no model outputs or quality results
splitRule: Separate calibration and held-out by task/repository family
execution: No inference runner is included or authorized. Supply sanitized repository fixtures and executable acceptance checks before a bounded trial.

cases.prompt: Format this JSON exactly; preserve every key
acceptance: JSON parses; values and keys match the original exactly.
Only formatting changes are permitted.

cases.prompt: Fix the race condition in the shared counter
acceptance: Concurrent increments preserve the total.
The regression test fails before and passes after the patch.

cases.prompt: Find the root cause of this intermittent timeout
acceptance: Explain the cause with reproducible evidence.
The correction passes the failing scenario and existing tests.

cases.prompt: Implement an endpoint and its client integration
acceptance: Server and client contract agree.
Integration and existing regression checks pass.

cases.prompt: Migrate the persisted configuration without losing overrides
acceptance: Old data migrates idempotently.
Unknown fields and user overrides are preserved.

cases.prompt: Fix the authorization bug without changing valid access
acceptance: Unauthorized requests are denied.
Authorized and cross-tenant controls retain their intended behavior.

cases.prompt: Document the supported library version from primary sources
acceptance: Claims cite documentation for the installed library version.
Unsupported capability claims are absent.
Request missing requirements rather than inventing scope.
No unrelated source or configuration changes.
The stated data problem is identified and corrected; existing tests still pass.

cases.prompt: it is not working, please fix it
acceptance: The failure is reproduced, explained and fixed; a regression test covers it.

cases.prompt: The checkout keeps crashing at random, figure out why
acceptance: Cause explained with reproducible evidence; the failing scenario passes after the fix.
No routing change.
